text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text:
Huh~?
Looks like you brought some friends with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ～？
仲間を連れてきちゃったみたいだね。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Ugh~ They're all such boring losers.
Seriously annoying...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぇ～、
映えないザコばっかじゃん。
マジうざ～……

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text:
And they look like they've got poison too... gross!
We'd better heal up before it gets dangerous,
or just wipe 'em out nice and quick!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あとあと、
毒とか持ってそうでやーな感じ！
危なくなる前に
しっかり治療するか、
ぱぱって倒していかないとだね！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for providing us with content,
but maybe it's time someone taught you that spamming is how you get hated~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネタをていきょーしてくれんのはいいけど、
連凸厄介勢は嫌われるってこと、
教えてあげますか～♡
